orientation.basis: All prominent Latin text has level horizontal baselines and reads left-to-right; the portrait panel stack and central background forms have vertical axes.

blindPixelObservations: Portrait frame with a heavily textured dark red, black, and blue background. A diffuse saturated red glow occupies much of the upper and central area.
Numerous thick dark curved lines cross the scene like cables or tubes. Thin vertical light streaks, small bright fragments, and red speckling are distributed across the background.
A narrow bright vertical form descends through the central red glow toward a reflective dark lower surface. Additional red rounded masses and dark angular structures occupy the center-right.

The lower portion contains a wide near-black title plaque overlapping a larger translucent dark body panel. Both have clipped corners, thin gold/orange outlines, and bilateral illuminated edge details.
A compact white-and-blue composite glyph followed by the uppercase word ALL is centered immediately above the title plaque.
The title is one centered line of large white uppercase text. The body is three centered lines of white mixed-case text, followed by a centered orange uppercase line near the panel bottom.
Orange diagonal strokes and vertical light capsules along the panel sides are mirrored and physically continuous with the frame, favoring decorative border elements rather than independent symbols.

iconMorphology.location: Upper center, directly left of ALL and immediately above PRIMARY SAMPLES.
iconMorphology.outerShape: Unenclosed composite consisting of several low concentric horizontal oval rings beneath a small, vertically symmetric solid-white upright form. The upright form has a rounded cap, narrow connecting neck, broad upper sides, paired short lateral projections, a tapered center, and two lower projections.
iconMorphology.internalMarks: The rounded cap contains no visible facial or letter-like marks. Dark negative gaps separate the lateral projections from the center and divide the lower pair. The oval base has cyan rims, dark-blue interiors, and visible gaps between successive rings.
iconMorphology.neighboringText: ALL immediately to the right; PRIMARY SAMPLES directly below.
iconMorphology.closestPlausibleAlternative: A pawn-, bottle-, or plume-like upright marker seated on ripple-like ovals.
iconMorphology.visibleDiscriminator: The silhouette has a distinct round cap plus bilateral side and split lower projections, rather than a pointed top or one continuous bottle-shaped contour.
